chunks.title: Pilot (Will & Grace)
chunks.text: It was written by David Kohan and Max Mutchnick, and directed by James Burrows.

chunks.title: Pilot (Will & Grace)
chunks.text: It originally aired on the National Broadcasting Company (NBC) in the United States on September 21, 1998.

chunks.title: Pilot (Will & Grace)
chunks.text: In the episode, Grace Adler receives an unexpected marriage proposal from her boyfriend.

chunks.title: Pilot (Will & Grace)
chunks.text: Her gay best friend Will Truman tries to support her, but finally tells her that she is making a big mistake, even though he risks losing their friendship.

chunks.title: Pilot (Will & Grace)
chunks.text: The situation gets complicated when Grace's socialite assistant, Karen Walker, and Will's flamboyantly gay friend, Jack McFarland, interfere.

chunks.title: Partners (2012 TV series)
chunks.text: Partners is an American comedy series that aired on CBS from September 24 to November 12, 2012, on Monday nights at 8:30 p.m., following the sitcom "How I Met Your Mother".

chunks.title: Partners (2012 TV series)
chunks.text: The series was created by "Will & Grace" creators Max Mutchnick and David Kohan, who also served as the show's executive producers and it stars Michael Urie, David Krumholtz, Sophia Bush, and Brandon Routh.

chunks.title: Four Kings
chunks.text: Four Kings is an American sitcom introduced as a part of NBC's winter 2006 programming but cancelled before the end of the season.

chunks.title: Four Kings
chunks.text: It aired at 8:30pm on Thursdays.

chunks.title: Four Kings
chunks.text: It starred Seth Green, Josh Cooke, Shane McRae, and Todd Grinnell.

chunks.title: Four Kings
chunks.text: The show was created by David Kohan and Max Mutchnick, both of whom created "Will & Grace".

chunks.title: Good Morning, Miami
chunks.text: Good Morning, Miami is a sitcom which ran from 2002 to 2004 on NBC.

chunks.title: Good Morning, Miami
chunks.text: Created by David Kohan and Max Mutchnick, the show focused on the personal and professional life of Jake, the executive producer of the lowest-rated morning show in the country, based in Miami.

chunks.title: Marry Me a Little, Marry Me a Little More
chunks.text: "Marry Me a Little, Marry Me a Little More" is a double-length episode of the American television series "Will & Grace"' s fifth season.

chunks.title: Marry Me a Little, Marry Me a Little More
chunks.text: It was written by Jeff Greenstein and Bill Wrubel and directed by series producer James Burrows.

chunks.title: Marry Me a Little, Marry Me a Little More
chunks.text: The episode originally aired on the National Broadcasting Company (NBC) in the United States on November 21, 2002.

chunks.title: Marry Me a Little, Marry Me a Little More
chunks.text: Guest stars in "Marry Me a Little, Marry Me a Little More" include Harry Connick Jr., Katie Couric, Judith Ivey, and Debbie Reynolds.

chunks.title: Rotrou IV, Count of Perche
chunks.text: Rotrou IV (1135-1191), Count of Perche, son of Rotrou III, Count of Perche, and Hawise, daughter of Walter of Salisbury, and Sibilla de Chaworth.

chunks.title: Rotrou IV, Count of Perche
chunks.text: Rotrou was from the House of Châteaudun and descended from the Viscounts of Châteaudun.

chunks.title: Rotrou IV, Count of Perche
chunks.text: His mother was a sister of Patrick of Salisbury, 1st Earl of Salisbury.

chunks.title: Rotrou IV, Count of Perche
chunks.text: Patrick’s sister Sibyll married John FitzGilbert, the Marshal of the Horses, whose son Henry was Bishop of Exeter and a knight in the service of Rotrou.

chunks.title: Crabbet Arabian Stud
chunks.text: The Crabbet Arabian Stud, also known as the Crabbet Park Stud, was a horse breeding farm established on 2 July 1878 when the first Arabian horses brought to England by Wilfrid Scawen Blunt and Lady Anne Blunt arrived at Crabbet Park, their estate in Sussex.

chunks.title: Crabbet Arabian Stud
chunks.text: Six months earlier, while staying in Aleppo, Wilfrid and Lady Anne had made a plan to import some of the best Arabian horses to England and breed them there.

chunks.title: Crabbet Arabian Stud
chunks.text: In Lady Anne's words, "it would be an interesting and useful thing to do and I should like much to try it."

chunks.title: Rotrou III, Count of Perche
chunks.text: Rotrou III (bef.

chunks.title: Rotrou III, Count of Perche
chunks.text: 1080 – [20 January/6 May] 1144), called the Great ("le Grand"), was the Count of Perche and Mortagne from 1099.

chunks.title: Rotrou III, Count of Perche
chunks.text: He was the son of Geoffrey II, Count of Perch, and Beatrix de Ramerupt, daughter of Hilduin IV, Count of Montdidier.

chunks.title: Rotrou III, Count of Perche
chunks.text: He was a notable Crusader and a participant in the "Reconquista" in eastern Spain, even ruling the city of Tudela in Navarre from 1123 to 1131.

chunks.title: Rotrou III, Count of Perche
chunks.text: He is commonly credited with introducing Arabian horses to the Perche, giving rise to the Percheron breed.

chunks.title: Rotrou III, Count of Perche
chunks.text: By his creation of a monastery at La Trappe in memory of his wife, Matilda, daughter of Henry I of England, in 1122 he also laid the foundations of the later Trappists.

chunks.title: German Warmblood
chunks.text: German Warmblood may refer generally to any of the various warmblood horses of Germany, or more specifically to a warmblood registered with the nationwide German Horse Breeding Society (ZfDP).

chunks.title: German Warmblood
chunks.text: Beneath the umbrella term "German warmblood" are several regional variations on a singular standard; individual German warmblood types are not necessarily considered "breeds", because they have an open stud book and freely exchange genetic material between each other, with other warmblood types, with Anglo-Arabians, and with breeds like the Thoroughbred, Arabian, and Trakehner.

chunks.title: German Warmblood
chunks.text: (The Trakehner, while a warmblood horse from Germany, has a closed stud book and thus, like the Thoroughbred and Arabian, is considered a "true" breed.)

chunks.title: Bardigiano
chunks.text: The Bardigiano is a breed of small horse from the Emilia Romagna region of Italy.

chunks.title: Bardigiano
chunks.text: It takes its name from the town of Bardi, in the Apennines of Parma, and is principally associated with the surrounding area and the Valle del Ceno.

chunks.title: Bardigiano
chunks.text: The mountain environment and steep, rough terrain of the area have contributed to produce a robust, hardy breed, agile and sure-footed over difficult ground.

chunks.title: Bardigiano
chunks.text: Although some males and all females are under  hands , the Bardigiano is always considered a horse in its home country.

chunks.title: Bardigiano
chunks.text: The stud book was established in 1977, and is held by the Associazione Provinciale Allevatori, the regional animal breeders' association, of Parma.

chunks.title: Bardigiano
chunks.text: The breed is widely distributed in Italy, with breeders in 26 Italian provinces; a recent study examined 3556 stud book entries for living horses.

chunks.title: Bardigiano
chunks.text: Due to these relatively large numbers, the breed is not considered to be at risk of extinction, but is classed as "vulnerable".

chunks.title: French Saddle Pony
chunks.text: The French Saddle Pony, also called the Poney Français de Selle, is pony breed developed as a sport pony for children and smaller adult riders.

chunks.title: French Saddle Pony
chunks.text: It was initially developed in 1969 as the Poney de Croisement (Cross-bred Pony), and in 1972 a stud book was created.

chunks.title: French Saddle Pony
chunks.text: In 1991 the stud book was closed and the breed renamed to Poney Français de Selle.

chunks.title: French Saddle Pony
chunks.text: The breed combines a mix of French and British pony breeds, as well as Thoroughbred and Arabian blood, to create the horse seen today.

chunks.title: French Saddle Pony
chunks.text: Due to the large number of breeds used to create the French Saddle Pony, there is not yet a defined set of physical characteristics for the breed, although all tend to be suited for competition in English riding disciplines, including dressage, show jumping and three-day eventing.

chunks.title: French Saddle Pony
chunks.text: They fill a similar role as the British Riding Pony and the German riding pony.

chunks.title: Purosangue Orientale
chunks.text: The Purosangue Orientale or Puro Sangue Orientale (PSO) (en: “Oriental Purebred”), is a horse breed developed in the Kingdom of Italy by Royal Decree n° 2690 of 19 September 1875, which created a stud book dedicated to the breed.

chunks.title: Purosangue Orientale
chunks.text: Beginning in 1864, the Italian Government had sent emissaries into Syria and Mesopotamia to purchase desert bred Arabian horses directly from Bedouin tribes.

chunks.title: Purosangue Orientale
chunks.text: Numerous stallions and mares were purchased and brought back to Sicily, many being destined for the Royal Remount Station in Catania.

chunks.title: Sella Italiano
chunks.text: Sella Italiano is an equine breed created in Italy.

chunks.title: Sella Italiano
chunks.text: The Italian Government has passed a law that created a stud book for the new breed.

chunks.title: Sella Italiano
chunks.text: The breed is blending the remnant indigenous Italian breeds of Maremmano, Salernitano and Persano horse with Anglo Arabo Sardo, Purosangue Orientale, Arabian and Thoroughbred.

chunks.title: Sella Italiano
chunks.text: The progeny of said horses can be registered as Sella Italiano if they can pass a “performance test”.

chunks.title: Sella Italiano
chunks.text: Furthermore, the stud book is open to other European warmbloods if they can pass the performance test and be approved by the breed registry.

chunks.title: Sella Italiano
chunks.text: The breed is intended to produce a sport horse which can compete successfully at the international level.

chunks.title: Yeguada Militar de Jerez de la Frontera
chunks.text: Yeguada Militar de Jerez de la Frontera, (en: "Military Stud of de Jerez de la Frontera") known outside Spain as the Yeguada Militar is the military Spanish stud farm headquartered in Andalusia, Spain, dedicated to horse breeding of purebred Andalusian horses and Arabian horses. Founded in 1847, it became the state military stud farm in 1893.

chunks.title: Yeguada Militar de Jerez de la Frontera
chunks.text: In the 20th century, as need for cavalry horses declined, the stud's emphasis shifted to become a genetic reservoir to preserve the bloodlines of the Pure Spanish Horse and to continue to breed high quality Arabian horses, with stallions of both breeds being made available to private horse breeders to improve the horses of Spain.

chunks.title: Yeguada Militar de Jerez de la Frontera
chunks.text: Today, there are two facilities located in the Jerez de la Frontera area, one primarily for stallions, the other for mares and foals, as well as multiple stallion depots across the country.

chunks.title: Percheron
chunks.text: The Percheron is a breed of draft horse that originated in the Huisne river valley in western France, part of the former Perche province from which the breed takes its name.

chunks.title: Percheron
chunks.text: Usually gray or black in color, Percherons are well muscled, and known for their intelligence and willingness to work.

chunks.title: Percheron
chunks.text: Although their exact origins are unknown, the ancestors of the breed were present in the valley by the 17th century.

chunks.title: Percheron
chunks.text: They were originally bred for use as war horses. Over time, they began to be used for pulling stagecoaches and later for agriculture and hauling heavy goods.

chunks.title: Percheron
chunks.text: In the late 18th and early 19th centuries, Arabian blood was added to the breed.

chunks.title: Percheron
chunks.text: Exports of Percherons from France to the United States and other countries rose exponentially in the late 19th century, and the first purely Percheron stud book was created in France in 1883.

chunks.title: David Thewlis
chunks.text: David Thewlis (born David Wheeler; born 20 March 1963) is an English actor, director, screenwriter, and author.

chunks.title: David Thewlis
chunks.text: His most commercially successful role to date has been that of Remus Lupin in the "Harry Potter" film series.

chunks.title: David Thewlis
chunks.text: Other notable performances include the films "Naked" (for which he won the Best Actor award at Cannes Film Festival), "Dragonheart", "Kingdom of Heaven", "The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas", "The Theory of Everything", "Black Beauty", "Macbeth" (as King Duncan) and "Wonder Woman".

chunks.title: David Thewlis
chunks.text: He has also done voice work in the films "James and the Giant Peach" (1996), "The Miracle Maker" (2000), and "Anomalisa" (2015).

chunks.title: David Thewlis
chunks.text: Thewlis has combined major motion picture work with prominent television roles, including playing Cyrus Crabb in the television miniseries "Dinotopia" and antagonist V.M. Varga in the third season of "Fargo."

chunks.title: Donalbain (Macbeth)
chunks.text: Donalbain is a character in William Shakespeare's "Macbeth" (c. 1603–1607).

chunks.title: Donalbain (Macbeth)
chunks.text: He is the younger son of King Duncan and brother to Malcolm, the heir to the throne.

chunks.title: Donalbain (Macbeth)
chunks.text: Donalbain flees to Ireland after the murder of his father for refuge.

chunks.title: The Big Lebowski
chunks.text: The Big Lebowski is a 1998 British-American crime comedy film written, produced, and directed by Joel and Ethan Coen.

chunks.title: The Big Lebowski
chunks.text: It stars Jeff Bridges as Jeffrey "The Dude" Lebowski, a Los Angeles slacker and avid bowler.

chunks.title: The Big Lebowski
chunks.text: He is assaulted as a result of mistaken identity, after which The Dude learns that a millionaire also named Jeffrey Lebowski was the intended victim.

chunks.title: The Big Lebowski
chunks.text: The millionaire Lebowski's trophy wife is kidnapped, and he commissions The Dude to deliver the ransom to secure her release; but the plan goes awry when the Dude's friend Walter Sobchak (John Goodman) schemes to keep the ransom money.

chunks.title: The Big Lebowski
chunks.text: Julianne Moore and Steve Buscemi also star, with David Huddleston, John Turturro, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Sam Elliott, Tara Reid, David Thewlis and Flea appearing in supporting roles.

chunks.title: War Horse (film)
chunks.text: War Horse is a 2011 British war drama film directed and co-produced by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay written by Lee Hall and Richard Curtis, adapted from English author Michael Morpurgo's 1982 novel of the same name.

chunks.title: War Horse (film)
chunks.text: The film's cast includes Jeremy Irvine (in his film acting debut), Emily Watson, David Thewlis, Tom Hiddleston, Benedict Cumberbatch, Eddie Marsan, Niels Arestrup, Toby Kebbell, David Kross and Peter Mullan.

chunks.title: War Horse (film)
chunks.text: Set before and during World War I, it tells of the journey of Joey, a bay Thoroughbred horse raised by British teenager Albert (Irvine), as he is bought by the British Army, leading him to encounter numerous individuals and owners throughout Europe, all the while experiencing the tragedies of the war happening around him.

chunks.title: Malcolm (Macbeth)
chunks.text: Malcolm is a character in William Shakespeare's "Macbeth" (c. 1603–1607).

chunks.title: Malcolm (Macbeth)
chunks.text: The character is based on the historical king Malcolm III of Scotland, and is derived largely from the account in "Holinshed's Chronicles" (1587), a history of Britain.

chunks.title: Malcolm (Macbeth)
chunks.text: He is the elder son of King Duncan, the heir to the throne, and brother to Donalbain.

chunks.title: Malcolm (Macbeth)
chunks.text: In the end, he regains the throne after mustering support to overthrow Macbeth.

chunks.title: Gangster No. 1
chunks.text: Gangster No. 1 (pronounced Gangster Number One) is a 2000 British crime drama film directed by Paul McGuigan and starring Paul Bettany in the title role.

chunks.title: Gangster No. 1
chunks.text: It also features Malcolm McDowell, David Thewlis and Saffron Burrows.

chunks.title: Gangster No. 1
chunks.text: It is based on the play "Gangster No.1" by Louis Mellis and David Scinto.

chunks.title: Naked (1993 film)
chunks.text: Naked is a 1993 British black comedy-drama film written and directed by Mike Leigh and starring David Thewlis as Johnny, a motor-mouthed intellectual and conspiracy theorist.

chunks.title: Naked (1993 film)
chunks.text: Stark and brutal in tone, "Naked" was a departure for Leigh, whose previous works were known for their subtle comedic dissections of middle-class and working-class manners.

chunks.title: Naked (1993 film)
chunks.text: Leigh's "Naked" screenplay relied heavily on lengthy improvisation during rehearsals, but little actual ad-libbing was filmed.

chunks.title: Naked (1993 film)
chunks.text: Critically acclaimed, the film won a number of awards, including best director and best actor at Cannes.

chunks.title: Naked (1993 film)
chunks.text: "Naked" marked a new career high for Leigh as a director and made the then-unknown Thewlis an internationally recognized star.

chunks.title: The Fifth Estate (film)
chunks.text: The Fifth Estate is a 2013 Indian-American biographical thriller film directed by Bill Condon, about the news-leaking website WikiLeaks.

chunks.title: The Fifth Estate (film)
chunks.text: The film stars Benedict Cumberbatch as its editor-in-chief and founder Julian Assange, and Daniel Brühl as its former spokesperson Daniel Domscheit-Berg.

chunks.title: The Fifth Estate (film)
chunks.text: Anthony Mackie, David Thewlis, Alicia Vikander, Stanley Tucci, and Laura Linney are featured in supporting roles.

chunks.title: The Fifth Estate (film)
chunks.text: The film's screenplay was written by Josh Singer based in-part on Domscheit-Berg's book "Inside WikiLeaks: My Time with Julian Assange at the World's Most Dangerous Website" (2011), as well as "" (2011) by British journalists David Leigh and Luke Harding.

chunks.title: The Fifth Estate (film)
chunks.text: The film's name is a term used to describe the people who operate in the manner of journalists outside the normal constraints imposed on the mainstream media.

chunks.title: King Duncan
chunks.text: King Duncan is a fictional character in Shakespeare's "Macbeth."

chunks.title: King Duncan
chunks.text: He is the father of two youthful sons (Malcolm and Donalbain), and the victim of a well-plotted regicide in a power grab by his trusted captain Macbeth.

chunks.title: King Duncan
chunks.text: The origin of the character lies in a narrative of the historical Donnchad mac Crinain, King of Scots, in Raphael Holinshed's 1587 "The Chronicles of England, Scotland, and Ireland," a history of Britain familiar to Shakespeare and his contemporaries.

chunks.title: King Duncan
chunks.text: Unlike Holinshed's incompetent King Duncan (who is credited in the narrative with a "feeble and slothful administration"), Shakespeare's King Duncan is crafted as a sensitive, insightful, and generous father-figure whose murder grieves Scotland and is accounted the cause of turmoil in the natural world.

chunks.title: Regression (film)
chunks.text: Regression is a 2015 Canadian-Spanish-American psychological thriller mystery film directed, produced and written by Alejandro Amenábar.

chunks.title: Regression (film)
chunks.text: The film stars Ethan Hawke and Emma Watson, with David Thewlis, Lothaire Bluteau, Dale Dickey, David Dencik, Peter MacNeill, Devon Bostick and Aaron Ashmore in supporting roles.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Taipei)
chunks.text: Liberty Square (also Freedom Square) is a public plaza covering over 240,000 square meters in the Zhongzheng District of Taipei, Taiwan.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Taipei)
chunks.text: It has served as the public gathering place of choice since its completion in the late 1970s.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Taipei)
chunks.text: The name of the square recalls the important historical role it played in Taiwan's transition from one-party rule to modern democracy in the 1990s.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Magic Kingdom)
chunks.text: Liberty Square is one of six "themed lands" and is exclusive to the Magic Kingdom, a theme park at the Walt Disney World Resort in Lake Buena Vista, Florida.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Magic Kingdom)
chunks.text: Themed after colonial America, replicas of both the Liberty Bell and Liberty Tree can be seen here.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Magic Kingdom)
chunks.text: One of the most popular attractions in the Magic Kingdom, the Haunted Mansion, is located in this land.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Magic Kingdom)
chunks.text: Presiding over the square is the Hall of Presidents, an American history show featuring an audio-animatronic figure of every President of the United States.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Magic Kingdom)
chunks.text: Liberty Square has a long waterfront on the Rivers of America and the "Liberty Belle" Riverboat steam paddleboat departs from a landing here.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Magic Kingdom)
chunks.text: The land affords excellent views of the river and Tom Sawyer Island in adjacent Frontierland.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Tolyatti)
chunks.text: Liberty Square (Russian: Площадь Свободы ) is a park in the Russian city of Tolyatti.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Tolyatti)
chunks.text: It is bounded by Liberty Street, Youth Street (on two sides), and Karl Marx Street.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Tolyatti)
chunks.text: It is also, by extension, the name used for the neighborhood around the park.

chunks.title: Liberty Square (Tolyatti)
chunks.text: Monuments of cultural and historical interest in or around Liberty Square include:

chunks.title: Vamp Building
chunks.text: The Vamp Building is a historic factory building at 3-15 Liberty Square in downtown Lynn, Massachusetts.

chunks.title: Vamp Building
chunks.text: The eight story brick building was built in 1903 to a design by local architect Henry Warren Rogers, and was extended over the next four years to occupy the entire city block bounded by Washington Street, Union Street, and Liberty Square.

chunks.title: Vamp Building
chunks.text: The "flatiron" V-shape of the building may have been a reason for its name.

chunks.title: Vamp Building
chunks.text: The building served in its early years as a home for all manner of businesses related to the manufacture of shoes.

chunks.title: Freedom Square, Yerevan
chunks.text: The Freedom Square or Liberty Square (Armenian: Ազատության հրապարակ, "Azatut'yan hraparak" ), also known as Opera Square and Theatre Square (Թատերական հրապարակ, "T'aterakan hraparak") until 1991, is a town square located in Kentron (Center) district of Yerevan, Armenia.

chunks.title: Freedom Square, Yerevan
chunks.text: The square is part of the Yerevan Opera Theater complex, located just to the south of the main opera building, between the opera park and the Swan lake.

chunks.title: Freedom Square, Yerevan
chunks.text: Along with the Republic Square, the Freedom Square is one of the two main squares in central Yerevan.

chunks.title: Freedom Square, Yerevan
chunks.text: It is bordered with four streets: Tumanyan Street, Teryan Street, Sayat Nova Avenue and Mashtots Avenue.

chunks.title: Freedom Square, Yerevan
chunks.text: The statues of writer Hovhannes Tumanyan and composer Alexander Spendiaryan are located in the square.

chunks.title: National Theater and Concert Hall, Taipei
chunks.text: The National Theater () and National Concert Hall () are twin performing arts venues at Liberty Square in Zhongzheng District, Taipei, Taiwan.

chunks.title: National Theater and Concert Hall, Taipei
chunks.text: Completed in 1987, the landmarks stand on the south and north sides of the square with Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall to the east.

chunks.title: National Theater and Concert Hall, Taipei
chunks.text: Together the venues are referred to by the abbreviation "NTCH".

chunks.title: National Theater and Concert Hall, Taipei
chunks.text: The square itself sits near Ketagalan Boulevard, site of the Presidential Office Building, the National Central Library, the National Taiwan Museum, and the 228 Peace Memorial Park.

chunks.title: De Neve Square Park
chunks.text: De Neve Square Park is a quaint urban pocket park located in the neighborhood of Holmby Hills in West Los Angeles, Los Angeles, California.

chunks.title: De Neve Square Park
chunks.text: It is located at the northern terminus of Mapleton Drive where it meets Saint Pierre Road at Beverly Glen Boulevard, where Holmby Hills borders East Gate Bel Air to the west.

chunks.title: De Neve Square Park
chunks.text: The trapezoidal (rather than square) park is ringed by mature sycamore trees as well as English-style street lamps from the 1920s (created exclusively for Holmby Hills).

chunks.title: De Neve Square Park
chunks.text: De Neve Square Park is one of two parks in Holmby Hills (the other being Holmby Park).

chunks.title: Mark Twain Riverboat
chunks.text: "Mark Twain" Riverboat is an attraction, located at the Disneyland theme park in Anaheim, California, on which passengers embark on a scenic, 12-minute journey around the Rivers of America.

chunks.title: Mark Twain Riverboat
chunks.text: Originally named "Mark Twain" Steamboat when the park opened in 1955, the stately, 5/8-scale stern-wheeler was the first functional riverboat to be built in the United States for fifty years.

chunks.title: Mark Twain Riverboat
chunks.text: Other Disney riverboat attractions now appear at Walt Disney World, Tokyo Disneyland and Disneyland Paris.

chunks.title: Passyunk Square, Philadelphia
chunks.text: Passyunk Square is a neighborhood in South Philadelphia bounded by Broad Street to the west, 6th Street to the east, Tasker Street to the south and Washington Avenue to the north.

chunks.title: Passyunk Square, Philadelphia
chunks.text: Passyunk Square is bordered by the Bella Vista, Hawthorne, Central South Philadelphia, Wharton and Point Breeze neighborhoods.

chunks.title: Passyunk Square, Philadelphia
chunks.text: The neighborhood got its Lenape name from the 1800s Passyunk Township, Pennsylvania which named Passyunk Square Park, located between 12th, 13th, Reed and Wharton Streets.

chunks.title: Passyunk Square, Philadelphia
chunks.text: The park was eventually renamed Columbus Square Park, and subsequently the neighborhood became known as Columbus Square.

chunks.title: Passyunk Square, Philadelphia
chunks.text: Geoff DiMasi revived the Passyunk Square name when forming the Passyunk Square Civic Association in 2003.

chunks.title: 15 Temmuz Kızılay Milli İrade Meydanı
chunks.text: July 15th Kızılay National Will Square, originally Kızılay Square (Turkish: "Kızılay Meydanı"), is one of the most important centers and junction points of Ankara, Turkey.

chunks.title: 15 Temmuz Kızılay Milli İrade Meydanı
chunks.text: After the 27 May 1960 coup d'état it was formally renamed as Hürriyet Meydanı (Liberty Square) but the popular use of "Kızılay Meydanı" continued.

chunks.title: 15 Temmuz Kızılay Milli İrade Meydanı
chunks.text: Following the failed coup attempt of 15 July 2016, Ankara Metropolitan Municipality initially decided on 26 July 2016 to rename the square as 15 Temmuz Kızılay Demokrasi Meydanı (July 15th Kızılay Democracy Square), which was later amended as 15 Temmuz Kızılay Milli İrade Meydanı (July 15th Kızılay National Will Square) on 9 August 2016.

chunks.title: Scatology (album)
chunks.text: Scatology is the debut full-length studio album by British experimental band Coil.

chunks.title: Scatology (album)
chunks.text: Recorded in 1984, "Scatology" was co-produced by Coil and JG Thirlwell, and features a prominent appearance of Stephen Thrower, which subsequently became Coil's official member since their next studio album, "Horse Rotorvator".

chunks.title: Scatology (album)
chunks.text: The album focuses on alchemy, mainly an idea of turning base matter into gold.

chunks.title: Scatology (album)
chunks.text: The contents of the album are having references to such a prominent figures as Marquis de Sade, Alfred Jarry, Salvador Dali, Charles Manson, and others.

chunks.title: Toxicity (album)
chunks.text: Toxicity is the second studio album by the Armenian-American heavy metal band System of a Down, released on September 4, 2001 by Columbia Records.

chunks.title: Toxicity (album)
chunks.text: Categorized as alternative metal, thrash metal, hard rock, art metal, heavy metal, and nu metal, "Toxicity" features elements of multiple genres of music: folk, progressive metal, progressive rock, jazz, Middle Eastern music, and Greek music.

chunks.title: Toxicity (album)
chunks.text: Many of the album's lyrics are political, being about topics such as the overpopulation of prisons, the CIA, and Charles Manson's beliefs about the environment.

chunks.title: Toxicity (album)
chunks.text: Examples of non-political themes in "Toxicity"'s lyrics are group sex, drug addiction, and groupies.

chunks.title: Never Learn Not to Love
chunks.text: "Never Learn Not to Love" is a song recorded by the American rock band the Beach Boys, credited to Dennis Wilson, and released as the B-side to the group's "Bluebirds over the Mountain" single on December 2, 1968.

chunks.title: Never Learn Not to Love
chunks.text: In 1969, "Never Learn Not to Love" was included on the Beach Boys' 15th studio album "20/20".

chunks.title: Never Learn Not to Love
chunks.text: The song was actually an altered version of "Cease to Exist", composed by aspiring folk singer-songwriter and later convicted murder-conspirator Charles Manson.

chunks.title: Never Learn Not to Love
chunks.text: Musically, Wilson deviated from Manson's blues influence, reworking it to fit the band's pop-oriented approach.

chunks.title: Helter Skelter (Manson scenario)
chunks.text: In the months leading up to the Tate/LaBianca murders in August 1969, Charles Manson often spoke to the members of his "Family" about Helter Skelter, an apocalyptic war arising from racial tensions between blacks and whites.

chunks.title: Helter Skelter (Manson scenario)
chunks.text: This "chimerical vision"—as it was termed by the court that heard Manson's appeal from his conviction for the killings—involved reference to music of the Beatles (particularly songs from their 1968 double album "The Beatles", also known as "the White Album") and to the New Testament's Book of Revelation.

chunks.title: Bad Moon Rising (album)
chunks.text: Bad Moon Rising is the second studio album by American rock band Sonic Youth.

chunks.title: Bad Moon Rising (album)
chunks.text: It was released in March 1985 on record labels Blast First and Homestead.

chunks.title: Bad Moon Rising (album)
chunks.text: The album is loosely themed around the dark side of America, and included references to obsession and insanity, Charles Manson, heavy metal, Satanism, and early European settlers' encounters with Native Americans.

chunks.title: The Manson Family Album
chunks.text: The Manson Family Album is the first studio recording by American rock band Marilyn Manson.

chunks.title: The Manson Family Album
chunks.text: It is a precursor to the band's debut studio album, 1994's "Portrait of an American Family".

chunks.title: The Manson Family Album
chunks.text: It was produced by Roli Mosimann, and is composed of original takes and mixes of songs which would later be found on their debut.

chunks.title: The Manson Family Album
chunks.text: However, the band's eponymous vocalist was unhappy with Mosimann's production, claiming it was too "smoothed and polished", and poorly representative of the band's established sound.

chunks.title: The Manson Family Album
chunks.text: The majority of songs on "The Manson Family Album" were later re-recorded or remixed with Nine Inch Nails frontman Trent Reznor at the Record Plant in Los Angeles.

chunks.title: The Manson Family Album
chunks.text: The album's title is a double entendre; it also relates to the commune of cult leader Charles Manson.

chunks.title: Helter Skelter (song)
chunks.text: "Helter Skelter" is a song by the English rock band the Beatles that was released in 1968 on their self-titled double album, often known as "the White Album".

chunks.title: Helter Skelter (song)
chunks.text: It was written by Paul McCartney and credited to Lennon–McCartney.

chunks.title: Helter Skelter (song)
chunks.text: The song was a product of McCartney's attempt to create a sound as loud and dirty as possible.

chunks.title: Helter Skelter (song)
chunks.text: The Beatles' recording has been noted for its "proto-metal roar" and is considered by music historians to be a key influence in the early development of heavy metal. "

chunks.title: Helter Skelter (song)
chunks.text: Rolling Stone" magazine ranked "Helter Skelter" 52nd on its list of the "100 Greatest Beatles songs".

chunks.title: Man That You Fear
chunks.text: "Man That You Fear" is a promotional-only single from Marilyn Manson's second studio album, "Antichrist Superstar", and is the final song on the album.

chunks.title: Man That You Fear
chunks.text: The song is inspired by what Manson had to grow up with and how it turned him into what he is now, a man or monster that people now have grown to fear.

chunks.title: Man That You Fear
chunks.text: The line, "Sticking to my pointy ribs/ Are all your infants in abortion cribs" refers to a story told in "The Long Hard Road Out of Hell" in which Manson as a child found a coffee can with something rotting inside.

chunks.title: Man That You Fear
chunks.text: His mother told him it was discarded meat, but later told him that it was actually an aborted fetus.

chunks.title: Man That You Fear
chunks.text: The song was initially penned during Manson's cousin Chad's wedding ceremony.

chunks.title: Helter Skelter (album)
chunks.text: Helter Skelter is the second studio album by The D.O.C.; released on January 23, 1996.

chunks.title: Helter Skelter (album)
chunks.text: This album was an attempt at making a comeback following the car crash which severely damaged his vocal cords.

chunks.title: Helter Skelter (album)
chunks.text: The album was widely ignored, and has even been discredited by D.O.C himself.

chunks.title: Helter Skelter (album)
chunks.text: The name of the album is a reference to Charles Manson's idea of The Beatles' "Helter Skelter" prophesying the end of the world.

chunks.title: Portrait of an American Family
chunks.text: Portrait of an American Family is the debut full-length studio album by American rock band Marilyn Manson.

chunks.title: Portrait of an American Family
chunks.text: It was released on July 19, 1994 in the US through Nothing and Interscope Records.

chunks.title: Portrait of an American Family
chunks.text: It was produced by Trent Reznor of Nine Inch Nails.

chunks.title: Portrait of an American Family
chunks.text: The album was initially known as "The Manson Family Album" – a direct reference to serial killer Charles Manson's own band – but was retitled prior to release.

chunks.title: Ochthera
chunks.text: Ochthera is a genus of flies in the family of Shore flies.

chunks.title: Ochthera
chunks.text: The genus is distinctive because of the swollen raptorial forelegs.

chunks.title: Ochthera
chunks.text: The larvae are predaceous on midge larvae while the adults feed on midges and mosquitoes.

chunks.title: Ochthera
chunks.text: The genus is found around the world with about 37 species.

chunks.title: Ochthera
chunks.text: The species "Ochthera chalybescens" has been shown to prey on African malaria vectors .

chunks.title: Brahminy kite
chunks.text: The brahminy kite ("Haliastur indus"), also known as the red-backed sea-eagle in Australia, is a medium-sized bird of prey in the family Accipitridae, which also includes many other diurnal raptors, such as eagles, buzzards, and harriers.

chunks.title: Brahminy kite
chunks.text: They are found in the Indian subcontinent, Southeast Asia, and Australia.

chunks.title: Brahminy kite
chunks.text: They are found mainly on the coast and in inland wetlands where they feed on dead fish and other prey.

chunks.title: Brahminy kite
chunks.text: Adults have a reddish-brown plumage and a contrasting white head and breast which makes them easy to distinguish from other birds of prey.

chunks.title: List of birds of Wales
chunks.text: This list of birds of Wales includes every species of bird that has been recorded in a wild state in Wales.

chunks.title: List of birds of Wales
chunks.text: Compared to the avifauna of Britain as a whole, Wales has fewer breeding species but these include a number of moorland species such as red grouse and black grouse, large numbers of seabirds (particularly on offshore islands such as Skomer, Grassholm and Bardsey) and good populations of several species typical of Welsh oak woods including redstart, pied flycatcher and wood warbler.

chunks.title: List of birds of Wales
chunks.text: Among the birds of prey is the red kite which had become extinct in other parts of Britain until being reintroduced recently.

chunks.title: List of birds of Wales
chunks.text: In winter many wildfowl and waders are found around the coast, attracted by the mild temperatures.

chunks.title: List of birds of Wales
chunks.text: In spring and autumn a variety of migrant and vagrant birds can be seen, particularly on headlands and islands.

chunks.title: Bald eagle
chunks.text: The bald eagle ("Haliaeetus leucocephalus", from Greek "hali" "sea", "aiētos" "eagle", "leuco" "white", "cephalos" "head") is a bird of prey found in North America.

chunks.title: Bald eagle
chunks.text: A sea eagle, it has two known subspecies and forms a species pair with the white-tailed eagle ("Haliaeetus albicilla").

chunks.title: Bald eagle
chunks.text: Its range includes most of Canada and Alaska, all of the contiguous United States, and northern Mexico.

chunks.title: Bald eagle
chunks.text: It is found near large bodies of open water with an abundant food supply and old-growth trees for nesting.

chunks.title: Red-lipped batfish
chunks.text: The red-lipped batfish or Galapagos batfish ("Ogcocephalus darwini") is a fish of unusual morphology found around the Galapagos Islands and off Peru at depths of 3 to .

chunks.title: Red-lipped batfish
chunks.text: Red-lipped batfish are closely related to rosy-lipped batfish ("Ogcocephalus porrectus"), which are found near Cocos Island off the Pacific coast of Costa Rica.

chunks.title: Red-lipped batfish
chunks.text: This fish is mainly known for its bright red lips.

chunks.title: Red-lipped batfish
chunks.text: Batfish are not good swimmers; they use their highly adapted pectoral fins to "walk" on the ocean floor.

chunks.title: Red-lipped batfish
chunks.text: When the batfish reaches maturity, its dorsal fin becomes a single spine-like projection (thought to function primarily as a lure for prey).

chunks.title: Red-lipped batfish
chunks.text: Like other anglerfish, the red-lipped batfish has a structure on its head known as illicium.

chunks.title: Red-lipped batfish
chunks.text: This structure is employed for attracting prey.

chunks.title: Commerson's dolphin
chunks.text: Commerson's dolphin ("Cephalorhynchus commersonii"), also referred to by the common names skunk dolphin, piebald dolphin or panda dolphin, is a small oceanic dolphin of the genus "Cephalorhynchus".

chunks.title: Commerson's dolphin
chunks.text: Commerson's dolphin has two geographically-isolated but locally-common subspecies.

chunks.title: Commerson's dolphin
chunks.text: The principal subspecies, "C.c.commersonii", has sharply-delineated black-and-white patterning and is found around the tip of South America.

chunks.title: Commerson's dolphin
chunks.text: The secondary subspecies, "C.c.kerguelenensis", is larger than "C.c.commersonii", has a less-sharply delineated dark and light grey patterning with a white ventral band, and is found around the Kerguelen Islands in the Indian Ocean.

chunks.title: Prionomyrmex
chunks.text: Prionomyrmex is an extinct genus of bulldog ants in the subfamily Myrmeciinae of the family Formicidae.

chunks.title: Prionomyrmex
chunks.text: It was first described by Gustav Mayr in 1868, after he collected a holotype worker of "P. longiceps" in Baltic amber.

chunks.title: Prionomyrmex
chunks.text: Three species are currently described, characterised by their long mandibles, slender bodies and large size.

chunks.title: Prionomyrmex
chunks.text: These ants are known from the Eocene and Late Oligocene, with fossil specimens only found around Europe.

chunks.title: Prionomyrmex
chunks.text: It is suggested that these ants preferred to live in jungles, with one species assumed to be an arboreal nesting species.

chunks.title: Prionomyrmex
chunks.text: These ants had a powerful stinger that was used to subdue prey.

chunks.title: Prionomyrmex
chunks.text: In 2000, it was suggested by Cesare Baroni Urbani that the living species "Nothomyrmecia macrops" and a species he described both belonged to "Prionomyrmex", but this proposal has not been widely accepted by the entomological community.

chunks.title: Prionomyrmex
chunks.text: Instead, scientists still classify the two genera distinctive from each other, making "Nothomyrmecia" a valid genus.

chunks.title: Finless porpoise
chunks.text: The Indo-Pacific finless porpoise ("Neophocaena phocaenoides "), or finless porpoise, is one of seven porpoise species.

chunks.title: Finless porpoise
chunks.text: Most of the population has been found around the Korean peninsula in the Yellow and East China Seas, although a freshwater population is found around Jiuduansha near Shanghai at the mouth of China's Yangtze River.

chunks.title: Finless porpoise
chunks.text: Genetic studies indicate that the finless porpoise is the most basal living member of the porpoise family.

chunks.title: Cornus drummondii
chunks.text: Cornus drummondii, commonly known as the roughleaf dogwood, is a small deciduous tree that is native primarily to the Great Plains and Midwestern regions of the United States.

chunks.title: Cornus drummondii
chunks.text: It is also found around the Mississippi River.

chunks.title: Cornus drummondii
chunks.text: It is uncommon in the wild, and is mostly found around forest borders.

chunks.title: Cornus drummondii
chunks.text: The roughleaf dogwood is used as a buffer strip around parking lots, in the median of highways and near the decks and patios of homes.

chunks.title: Cornus drummondii
chunks.text: It can grow to a height of 15 to 25 feet (4.6 - 7.6 m) with a spread of 10 to 15 feet (3.1 - 4.6 m).

chunks.title: Cornus drummondii
chunks.text: The roughleaf dogwood flowers during the summer months.

chunks.title: Cornus drummondii
chunks.text: It produces off-white four-petaled open flowers that are followed by small white fruits that ripen from August to October.

chunks.title: Cornus drummondii
chunks.text: These dogwoods can form a dense thicket that is used as a hedge, border or cover for wildlife.

chunks.title: Cornus drummondii
chunks.text: At least forty species of birds are known to feed on the fruits of the roughleaf dogwood.

chunks.title: Brackendale, British Columbia
chunks.text: Brackendale is a small community in the Canadian province of British Columbia just north of Squamish town centre, but still within the District of Squamish.

chunks.title: Brackendale, British Columbia
chunks.text: It is located near the confluence of the Squamish River and the Cheakamus River.

chunks.title: Brackendale, British Columbia
chunks.text: It is intersected primarily by Government Road and Depot Road.

chunks.title: Brackendale, British Columbia
chunks.text: The CN railway (formerly BC Rail) traverses it north–south.

chunks.title: Brackendale, British Columbia
chunks.text: It includes the remarkable "'Eagle Run" area, the wintering home of thousands of Bald eagles.

chunks.title: Cocktail Mixxx
chunks.text: Cocktail Mixxx is a remix album released on March 6, 2007 by the Revolting Cocks on 13th Planet Records.

chunks.title: Cocktail Mixxx
chunks.text: All of the original songs can be found on the band's previous album, Cocked and Loaded, and are remixed in their order of appearance on the promotional issue of that album, with "Fire Engine" having a second remix appear at the end.

chunks.title: Cocktail Mixxx
chunks.text: Original member Luc Van Acker and longtime contributor Phildo Owens remixed a track each on the record, but the other nine tracks were remixed by Clayton Worbeck.

chunks.title: Cocktail Mixxx
chunks.text: The second remix of "Fire Engine" features Josh Bradford on vocals.

chunks.title: Remixed (Amber album)
chunks.text: Remixed is a greatest hits/remix album by dance/pop singer Amber.

chunks.title: Remixed (Amber album)
chunks.text: It was released in 2000 and has hits from the albums This Is Your Night and Amber.

chunks.title: Remixed (Amber album)
chunks.text: It also includes a new song entitled Taste The Tears.

chunks.title: Remixed (Amber album)
chunks.text: The album contains 14 songs in total with each song having two versions.

chunks.title: Remixed (Amber album)
chunks.text: The only two songs that don't have a second remix are "Colour of Love" and "One More Night".

chunks.title: Hannah Montana Hits Remixed
chunks.text: Hannah Montana Hits Remixed is the second remix album by American pop recording artist Miley Cyrus, in the role of the character Hannah Montana.

chunks.title: Hannah Montana Hits Remixed
chunks.text: It was the fifth "Hannah Montana" album released on August 19, 2008, exclusively at American Wal-Mart stores.

chunks.title: Hannah Montana Hits Remixed
chunks.text: The album features singles from both of the previous television soundtracks, "Hannah Montana" and "Hannah Montana 2".

chunks.title: Hannah Montana Hits Remixed
chunks.text: Several writers and producers worked on the songs, mainly Matthew Gerrard and Robbie Nevil.

chunks.title: Hannah Montana Hits Remixed
chunks.text: The album peaked at number one hundred-three in "Billboard" 200 and at four in Top Kid Audio.

chunks.title: Hannah Montana Hits Remixed
chunks.text: All songs were remixed by music producers Marco Marinangeli and Simone Sello.

chunks.title: Los Remixes 2.0
chunks.text: Los Remixes 2.0 (English: "The Remixes 2.0") is the second remix album and seventh album by Mexican-American cumbia group A.B. Quintanilla y Los Kumbia Kings and the second remix album by Mexican-American musician A.B. Quintanilla.

chunks.title: Los Remixes 2.0
chunks.text: It was released on April 6, 2004 by EMI Latin.

chunks.title: Hannah Montana 2: Meet Miley Cyrus
chunks.text: Hannah Montana 2: Meet Miley Cyrus is a double album by American singer and actress Miley Cyrus and her fictional character Hannah Montana from the television series of the same name.

chunks.title: Hannah Montana 2: Meet Miley Cyrus
chunks.text: It was released on June 26, 2007, by Walt Disney Records and Hollywood Records.

chunks.title: Hannah Montana 2: Meet Miley Cyrus
chunks.text: The first disc serves as the soundtrack album from the second season of "Hannah Montana", while the second disc serves as the debut studio album by Cyrus, the series' primary actress.

chunks.title: Hannah Montana 2: Meet Miley Cyrus
chunks.text: All twenty tracks are performed by Cyrus, although the first disc is credited to her character Hannah Montana in the vein of the original soundtrack, "Hannah Montana" (2006).

chunks.title: Hannah Montana 2: Meet Miley Cyrus
chunks.text: The lyrical themes revolve largely around "girl power", teen romance, and the double life that Cyrus' character lives on the program.

chunks.title: Bloom: Remix Album
chunks.text: Bloom: Remix Album is the second remix album by Canadian singer Sarah McLachlan, released in North America on 6 September 2005 by Nettwerk in Canada and Arista Records in the United States.

chunks.title: Bloom: Remix Album
chunks.text: It includes various dance club versions of McLachlan's songs, remixed by prominent remixers and producers.

chunks.title: Ordinary Girl (Hannah Montana song)
chunks.text: "Ordinary Girl" is a song by American singer–songwriter and actress Miley Cyrus, performing as Hannah Montana – the alter ego of Miley Stewart – a character she plays on the Disney Channel television series "Hannah Montana".

chunks.title: Ordinary Girl (Hannah Montana song)
chunks.text: It was released to Radio Disney on July 2, 2010 as promotion for the fourth season of "Hannah Montana".

chunks.title: Ordinary Girl (Hannah Montana song)
chunks.text: Lyrically, the track speaks about how Hannah Montana might be famous, but she is just an ordinary girl underneath.

chunks.title: Ordinary Girl (Hannah Montana song)
chunks.text: The song was later released on July 6, 2010 through digital distribution as the lead single from the soundtrack of the same title as the special title ("Hannah Montana Forever") of the fourth and final season of the series.

chunks.title: Thalía's Hits Remixed
chunks.text: Thalía's Hits Remixed is a remix album by Latin pop singer Thalía released on 25 February 2003 in North America.

chunks.title: Thalía's Hits Remixed
chunks.text: It contains remixes of many of her hits, such as "Amor a la Mexicana", "Piel Morena", "No Me Enseñaste" and "Tú y Yo."

chunks.title: Thalía's Hits Remixed
chunks.text: The album contains the English version of "Arrasando", called "It's My Party" that was released only on CD single back in 2001.

chunks.title: Thalía's Hits Remixed
chunks.text: And includes the previously unreleased medley that Thalía recorded especially for her the 2001 Latin Grammy Awards performance.

chunks.title: Thalía's Hits Remixed
chunks.text: That later was cancelled, due the 9/11 attack.

chunks.title: Thalía's Hits Remixed
chunks.text: It was certified Disco De Platino by the Recording Industry Association of America.

chunks.title: Thalía's Hits Remixed
chunks.text: In the Japanese version, the remix of "The Mexican (Dance Dance)"' used was the "Hex Hector-Mac Qualye Radio Remix".

chunks.title: Hannah Montana 2: Non-Stop Dance Party
chunks.text: Hannah Montana 2: Non-Stop Dance Party is the first remix album for the television series "Hannah Montana", released on January 29, 2008 by Walt Disney Records.

chunks.title: Hannah Montana 2: Non-Stop Dance Party
chunks.text: It includes remixed versions of songs previously featured on its second soundtrack "" (2007).

chunks.title: Hannah Montana 2: Non-Stop Dance Party
chunks.text: All eleven tracks are performed by the series' primary actress Miley Cyrus, and are credited to the title character Hannah Montana.

chunks.title: Miley Cyrus
chunks.text: Miley Ray Cyrus (born Destiny Hope Cyrus; November 23, 1992) is an American singer, songwriter, and actress.

chunks.title: Miley Cyrus
chunks.text: After playing minor roles in the television series "Doc" and the film "Big Fish" in her childhood, she became a teen idol starring as the character Miley Stewart in the Disney Channel television series "Hannah Montana" in 2006.

chunks.title: Miley Cyrus
chunks.text: Her father Billy Ray Cyrus also starred in the show.

chunks.title: Miley Cyrus
chunks.text: She subsequently signed a recording contract with Hollywood Records, and her debut studio album "" (2007) was certified triple-platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) having shipped over three million units.

chunks.title: Miley Cyrus
chunks.text: She released her second album "Breakout" and launched her film career as a voice actress in the animated film "Bolt" in 2008.

chunks.title: Mehdi Mohammed Zeyo
chunks.text: Mehdi Mohammed Zeyo (c. 1962 – 20 February 2011) was a Libyan middle manager for a state oil company in Benghazi, Libya.

chunks.title: Mehdi Mohammed Zeyo
chunks.text: In the wake of the Libyan Civil War, Zeyo found he could no longer bury the civilian youth killed by Muammar Gaddafi's forces; he subsequently decided to use his car to blow up the gates to a military base in Benghazi.

chunks.title: Mehdi Mohammed Zeyo
chunks.text: This allowed the civilian oppositional fighters to overrun the base and claim Benghazi as an oppositional stronghold in the Libyan Civil War.

chunks.title: Timeline of the 2011 Libyan Civil War
chunks.text: The timeline of the Libyan Civil War begins on 15 February 2011 and ends on 20 October 2011.

chunks.title: Timeline of the 2011 Libyan Civil War
chunks.text: It begins with a series of peaceful protests, similar to others of the Arab Spring, later becoming a full-scale civil war between the forces loyal to Muammar Gaddafi's government and the anti-Gaddafi forces.

chunks.title: Timeline of the 2011 Libyan Civil War
chunks.text: The conflict can roughly be divided into two periods before and after external military intervention authorized by United Nations Security Council Resolution 1973.

chunks.title: Ahmed al-Gaddafi al-Qahsi
chunks.text: Ahmed al-Gaddafi al-Qahsi (Arabic: أحمد القذافي‎ ‎ ; born 20th century - died 26 July 2011) was the cousin of former Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi.

chunks.title: Ahmed al-Gaddafi al-Qahsi
chunks.text: In 2006, he married Gaddafi's daughter Ayesha.

chunks.title: Ahmed al-Gaddafi al-Qahsi
chunks.text: According to the Gaddafi family, Qahsi, who was a Colonel in the Libyan Army, was killed in the 26 July 2011 bombing of the Gaddafi compound during the Libyan Civil War.

chunks.title: Ahmed al-Gaddafi al-Qahsi
chunks.text: The couple had three children before the conflict started.

chunks.title: Ahmed al-Gaddafi al-Qahsi
chunks.text: His fourth child, a girl, was born in Algeria as Ayesha fled there with her brothers Hannibal and Muhammad after the Battle of Tripoli.

chunks.title: Al-Saadi Gaddafi
chunks.text: Al-Saadi Muammar Gaddafi (Arabic: الساعدي معمر القذافي‎ ‎ ; born 25 May 1973), is the third son of former Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi.

chunks.title: Al-Saadi Gaddafi
chunks.text: He is a Libyan former association football player.

chunks.title: Al-Saadi Gaddafi
chunks.text: In 2011, he was the commander of Libya's Special Forces and was involved in the Libyan Civil War.

chunks.title: Al-Saadi Gaddafi
chunks.text: An Interpol notice has been issued against him.

chunks.title: Al-Saadi Gaddafi
chunks.text: On 5 March 2014, he was arrested in Niger and extradited to Libya, where he faces murder charges.

chunks.title: Al-Saadi Gaddafi
chunks.text: In August 2015, video surfaced allegedly showing Gaddafi being tortured.

chunks.title: Bashir Saleh Bashir
chunks.text: Bashir Saleh Bashir was a former aide of former Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi.

chunks.title: Bashir Saleh Bashir
chunks.text: He was head of the Libyan African Portfolio, a sovereign wealth fund that invested Libya’s oil wealth mostly in sub-Saharan Africa, and served as an intermediary between Libya, Africa and France.

chunks.title: Bashir Saleh Bashir
chunks.text: Bashir was captured after the Battle of Tripoli during the Libyan Civil War but later escaped.

chunks.title: Bashir Saleh Bashir
chunks.text: Libya demanded that he be extradited because it is believed he is in France.

chunks.title: Bashir Saleh Bashir
chunks.text: Bashir spent Libya's oil money solely for the Gaddafi family, buying up hotels, mineral resources and shares in companies, eventually becoming what some Libyan officials and financial experts describe as one of the largest single investors in Africa.

chunks.title: Bashir Saleh Bashir
chunks.text: Libyan authorities believe that finding him is the key to finding a missing 7 billion dollars in Libyan funds.

chunks.title: Libyan Civil War (2011–present)
chunks.text: The Libyan Civil War refers to the ongoing conflicts in Libya, beginning with the Arab Spring protests of 2011, which led to the First Libyan Civil War, foreign military intervention, and the ousting and death of Muammar Gaddafi.

chunks.title: Libyan Civil War (2011–present)
chunks.text: The civil war's aftermath and proliferation of armed groups led to violence and instability across the country, which erupted into renewed civil war in 2014.

chunks.title: Libyan Civil War (2011–present)
chunks.text: The ongoing crisis in Libya has so far resulted in tens of thousands of casualties since the onset of violence in early 2011.

chunks.title: Libyan Civil War (2011–present)
chunks.text: During both civil wars, the output of Libya's economically crucial oil industry collapsed to a small fraction of its usual level, with most facilities blockaded or damaged by rival groups, despite having the largest oil reserves of any African country.

chunks.title: Libyan Civil War (2011–present)
chunks.text: U.S. President Barack Obama stated on 11 April 2016 that not preparing for a post-Gaddafi Libya was probably the "worst mistake" of his presidency.

chunks.title: Battle of Ajdabiya
chunks.text: The Battle of Ajdabiya was an armed battle in and near the city of Ajdabiya that took place as part of the Libyan Civil War.

chunks.title: Battle of Ajdabiya
chunks.text: It was fought between anti-government rebels and military forces loyal to the Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi.

chunks.title: Battle of Ajdabiya
chunks.text: Following the Second Battle of Brega, in which pro-Gaddafi forces captured the town, Ajdabiya was the only major rebel-held city left en route to the rebel capital of Benghazi.

chunks.title: Battle of Ajdabiya
chunks.text: The battle for Ajdabiya had been cited as a potential turning point in the conflict on which the fate of the whole rebellion against the Gaddafi government may be decided.

chunks.title: Battle of Ajdabiya
chunks.text: On 26 March 2011, Libyan rebels, backed by extensive allied air raids, seized control of the frontline oil town of Ajdabiya from Colonel Muammar Gaddafi's forces.

chunks.title: Battle of Ajdabiya
chunks.text: During the first phase of the battle, pro-Gaddafi forces seized the strategic road junction leading to Benghazi and Tobruk, and captured most of the city.

chunks.title: Battle of Ajdabiya
